system: ENGINEERING MINIGAME (crafting discipline: sequential cognitive puzzles — pipe rotation + lights-out logic switches)
summary: Engineering crafting runs an untimed-per-puzzle, wall-clock-limited sequence of exactly 2+ puzzles per device: puzzle 0 is always a RotationPipePuzzle (rotate pipes to connect input→output, verified by BFS), puzzles 1+ are always LogicSwitchPuzzles (lights-out: click toggles cell+orthogonal neighbors to match a target pattern). Difficulty derives from recipe materials: points = Σ(tier×qty) × diversity(1+0.1/extra unique) × slots(1+0.05/extra slot), linearly interpolated over 1–80 points into time limit (300→120s), grid size (3→4), hints (4→1), and ideal moves (6/7/8 via a 12-tier lookup). Performance = completion×0.5 + avg_puzzle_efficiency×0.3 + time bonus (effectively 0 due to an order-of-operations bug) − 0.05/hint (hints never wired), +0.05 first-try; rewards come from a separate centralized calculator (quality tier, bonus_pct, efficiency multiplier, durability bonus) which independently applies a 0.10 first-try bonus. Output rarity mirrors uniform input-material rarity, with category rarity modifiers applied to generated crafted stats. Multiple bugs-to-preserve documented, most notably time_ratio always 0 at end() and puzzle_count effectively always 2.
player_facing: Player crafts an engineering recipe → minigame opens in 1000x700 workbench-styled window, right-aligned in viewport (core/game_engine.py:10488-10490)
Per-puzzle info overlay (blocking) shows puzzle type, mode, grid size, ideal moves, difficulty points, and 'max_bonus' displayed as 1.0 + points×0.02 (core/game_engine.py:10508-10548, 2468-2479)

Rotation pipe puzzle: click a cell to rotate that pipe piece 90° clockwise; goal is connecting the input cell (row 0) to the output cell (last row); empty and cross pieces don't rotate (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:196-203, 69-70)

Logic switch puzzle: click a cell to toggle it AND its orthogonal neighbors (lights-out); goal is matching the target pattern; four modes: random→fully_lit, random→fully_dim, fully_dim→random, fully_lit→random (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:304-323, 474-499)
Logic switch UI has a view-toggle button sliding between 'current' and 'target' grid views (animation state only, no puzzle effect) (core/game_engine.py:2422-2431)
Reset button restores the current logic-switch puzzle to its initial grid and zeroes the move counter (core/game_engine.py:2432-2436; Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:501-504)
Solve check runs automatically after every rotate/toggle click; console prints per-puzzle efficiency; advancing shows the next puzzle's info overlay (core/game_engine.py:2441-2479)

Overall wall-clock time limit (300s easy → 120s hard, extended by skill time buffs and INT); on expiry the minigame auto-ends with partial credit — no hard fail (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:737-747; core/difficulty_calculator.py:489)
Double-ESC within 1500ms abandons the craft (single ESC shows 'Press ESC again to abandon craft (materials lost)' warning) (core/game_engine.py:709-726)

On completion: result message 'Device created! Solved X/Y puzzles. Efficiency: Z%', materials consumed, output item added with rarity + crafted stats + quality tier (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:1017; core/game_engine.py:8970-8979)
All input materials must share the same rarity or crafting is blocked with 'Mixed rarities' error (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:1134-1138; Crafting-subdisciplines/rarity_utils.py:82-112)
Instant craft (skip minigame) exists: deducts materials, outputs base device at input rarity, no stats bonus (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:1142-1178)
mechanics: PUZZLE SEQUENCE: puzzle_count = max(2, calculator value) → puzzle 0 ALWAYS RotationPipePuzzle, puzzle 1+ ALWAYS LogicSwitchPuzzle; generated at start() (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:681, 757-796, 731-735)
RotationPipe difficulty label by tier: common→easy, uncommon/rare→medium, epic/legendary→hard (label stored but UNUSED by generation) (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:777-784, 62-65)

LogicSwitch difficulty by tier: common/uncommon/rare→easy (random_to_lit|random_to_dim), epic→medium (dim_to_random|lit_to_random), legendary→hard (lit_to_random); max_moves = ideal_moves (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:787-796, 349-364)

PIPE GENERATION: input=(0, rand_col), output=(grid_size-1, rand_col); ideal_path_length = Manhattan distance + 1; winding path built by biased walk — sort neighbors by distance-to-output, pick nearest with p=0.7 else random unvisited neighbor, backtrack on dead-end (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:69-71, 83-84, 92-116)

PIPE PIECES: types 0=empty,1=straight,2=L-bend,3=T,4=cross with CONNECTIONS map per rotation (sides 0=top,1=right,2=bottom,3=left); path endpoints get straight pieces (vertical if neighbor above/below else horizontal), middles get straight or L-bend matched to the two neighbor directions; all remaining cells filled with distractors random.choice([1,2,2,3]) at random rotation; then ALL non-empty/non-cross pieces scrambled to random rotation (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:54-60, 123-157, 159-194)

PIPE SOLVE CHECK: BFS from input_pos over pieces whose CONNECTIONS mutually link (my side S → neighbor has opposite(S)); solved when output_pos reached — ANY connected route counts, including through distractor pieces (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:222-285)
PIPE EFFICIENCY: min(1.0, ideal_path_length / actual_path_length) — fixed at generation time; player clicks tracked but never scored (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:205-220, 73, 201)

LOGIC SWITCH GENERATION: apply exactly max_moves toggles at distinct random cells (cells_used set prevents repeats, clears if exhausted); forward modes (random_to_X): target uniform, start = target scrambled by toggles; reversed modes (X_to_random): start uniform, target = start copy scrambled by toggles; ideal_moves = len(solution_path); initial_grid saved for reset (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:366-464)
LOGIC SWITCH TOGGLE: flip cell + orthogonal in-bounds neighbors (1−value); player toggle increments moves; solved when grid == target exactly (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:466-499, 506-512)
LOGIC SWITCH EFFICIENCY: 1.0 if moves ≤ ideal_moves, else e^−(moves/ideal − 1); ideal_moves==0 → 1.0 (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:514-528)

DIFFICULTY: base_points = Σ TIER_POINTS[tier]×quantity (tier from MaterialDatabase, default 1; min 1.0); diversity = 1.0+(unique_materials−1)×0.1; slot_modifier = 1.0+(total_slots−1)×0.05 where total_slots = Σ quantities; total = base×diversity×slot_mod (core/difficulty_calculator.py:130-175, 178-204, 567-579)

INTERPOLATION: normalized = clamp01((points−1.0)/(80.0−1.0)); each param = easy + (hard−easy)×normalized; then puzzle_count=max(1,round), grid_size=max(3,round), complexity=clamp(1..4,round), hints=max(0,round), time_limit=int(round) (core/difficulty_calculator.py:253-283, 581-589)

ideal_moves comes from 12-tier lookup table on total points (6/6/6/6/7/7/7/7/8/8/8/8 at thresholds 8/13/18/23/35/44/50/56/68/76/100/999), NOT from the interpolated (6,8) param (core/difficulty_calculator.py:517-531, 534-550, 591-592)
difficulty_tier: common 0-4, uncommon 5-10, rare 11-20, epic 21-40, legendary 41-150, >150 legendary (core/difficulty_calculator.py:47-53, 754-772)

TIME LIMIT MODIFIERS (applied in order): __init__ time_limit ×= (1+buff_time_bonus) from skill buffs; then engine INT pass: time_limit ×= min(1.6, 1 + min(INT,30)×0.02) (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:655-659; core/game_engine.py:4303-4316, 4382-4389)

TIMING: start_time = time.time() wall clock; update(dt) ignores dt, computes elapsed vs time_limit; on expiry sets time_expired and calls end() (auto-complete with partial credit); engine skips update() while metadata overlay blocks but wall clock keeps running (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:720-755; core/game_engine.py:8554-8558)

SOLVE FLOW: check_current_puzzle() → if solved: append puzzle + its efficiency (1.0 default if no get_efficiency_score), advance index; when index ≥ count → end() (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:844-875)

PERFORMANCE (end()): completion_ratio = solved/max(1,count); avg_efficiency = mean(puzzle_efficiencies) else 1.0; time_ratio = get_time_remaining()/max(1,time_limit) — ALWAYS 0 because active=False is set before the read (see hazards); base = completion×0.5 + avg_eff×0.3; if all solved and not expired: += time_ratio×0.2 (=0); elif all solved (expired): += 0.1; performance = clamp01(base − hints_used×0.05); if attempt==1: performance = min(1, performance + first_try_bonus('engineering')=0.05) (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:915-970; core/reward_calculator.py:52-74)

DEVICE STATS: base {durability:100, efficiency:100, accuracy:100, power:100}; per solved puzzle i, stat_types[i%4] += int(5 + 15×efficiency_i); quality = Σstats/(4×100); earned_points = int(performance×100), max_points = 100 (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:936-950, 996-1001)

REWARDS (calculate_engineering_rewards): max_multiplier = 1.0 + clamp01((points−1)/79)×1.5 (1.0→2.5); own performance = clamp01(solved/total + time_remaining_frac×0.2 − hints×0.1), attempt==1 adds +0.10 (default boost, NOT the 0.05 engineering override); bonus_pct = int(perf×(max_mult−1)×20); quality_tier from thresholds Normal<0.25≤Fine<0.50≤Superior<0.75≤Masterwork<0.90≤Legendary; efficiency_multiplier = 1+perf×(max_mult−1)×0.4; durability_bonus = int(perf×50) (core/reward_calculator.py:81-104, 371-437, 123-143, 34-40, 107-120)

CRAFT RESOLUTION (craft_with_minigame): tier-scaled FAILURE_PENALTIES common 0.30/uncommon 0.45/rare 0.60/epic 0.75/legendary 0.90 (only used by the abandoned branch which returns (1−penalty) of materials — dead path, see hazards); success path does NOT deduct materials (engine's RecipeDatabase.consume_materials at completion is single source of truth); rarity = uniform input rarity (fallback 'common'); crafted stats = generate_crafted_stats(minigame_result, recipe, item_type from EquipmentDatabase default 'tool') then rarity modifiers per item category (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:1203-1315)
CRAFTED STATS: quality = int(earned/max × 100); durability_multiplier = (quality−50)/100.0 giving −0.5..+0.5 (entities/components/crafted_stats.py:80-96)

RARITY: uniformity check over inputs' materialId → all must match (debug_mode bypasses as 'common'); apply_rarity_modifiers: 'common' = passthrough copy; else per-category/rarity numeric modifiers multiply int(stat×(1+bonus)) plus special_effects dict attached (Crafting-subdisciplines/rarity_utils.py:82-112, 129-173)

ENGINE WIRING: clicks routed via engineering_puzzle_rects list of (rect, (action,row,col)) → handle_action('rotate'|'toggle'|'reset'|'slide'); view_toggle/reset skip the solve check; generic minigame button calls check_current_puzzle() for placeholder puzzles; when minigame.result is non-None the engine calls _complete_minigame (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:798-831; core/game_engine.py:2409-2494, 8560-8566)

LEGACY FALLBACK if difficulty_calculator import fails: points = stationTier×15, tier name = [common,uncommon,rare,epic][tier−1], time 300s, grid 3+tier, hints max(0,4−tier), ideal_moves min(8,5+tier), puzzle_count 2/2/3/4 by tier (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:692-718)

DEPRECATED SlidingTilePuzzle auto-solves on any 'slide' action (save-file compat only); TrafficJamPuzzle/PatternMatchingPuzzle are empty placeholders — do not port as gameplay (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:547-580, 583-619)
data: recipes.JSON/recipes-engineering-1.json → {recipes:[{recipeId, outputId, outputQty, stationTier, inputs:[{itemId|materialId, quantity}]}]}, keyed by recipeId; loaded via get_resource_path with relative-path fallbacks (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:1059-1084)
MaterialDatabase (items JSONs) → material.tier (1-4) for difficulty points; missing material defaults tier 1 (core/difficulty_calculator.py:151-173)

stats-calculations.JSON via engine stat_modifiers_config → intelligence.reductionPerPoint (default 0.02), intelligence.maxEffectiveINT (default 30), intelligence.engineering.timeLimitMultiplier.maximumMultiplier (default 1.6) (core/game_engine.py:4303-4389)
Real recipe difficulty spread for calibration: simple_bomb 6.6 pts … jetpack 122.2 pts (comments enumerate all 16 recipes with points) (core/difficulty_calculator.py:513-531)
constants: TIER_POINTS {T1:1, T2:2, T3:3, T4:4} per item, linear (core/difficulty_calculator.py:35-40)
Diversity multiplier +0.1 per extra unique material; slot modifier +0.05 per extra total slot (core/difficulty_calculator.py:204, 577)
Interpolation domain: min_points 1.0, max_points 80.0 (core/difficulty_calculator.py:56-59)
ENGINEERING_PARAMS easy→hard: time_limit (300,120)s, puzzle_count (1,2), grid_size (3,4), complexity (1,3), hints_allowed (4,1), ideal_moves (6,8) (core/difficulty_calculator.py:487-509)
DIFFICULTY_THRESHOLDS: common (0,4), uncommon (5,10), rare (11,20), epic (21,40), legendary (41,150) (core/difficulty_calculator.py:47-53)
Pipe path-gen bias: p=0.7 toward nearest-to-output neighbor; distractor fill weights [straight, L, L, T]; rotations {0,90,180,270} (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:113, 143-144, 157)
Ideal path length = Manhattan + 1; pipe efficiency = min(1, ideal/actual) (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:83-84, 219-220)
Logic switch efficiency decay: e^−(moves/ideal − 1) beyond ideal (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:528)
Performance weights: completion 0.5, avg efficiency 0.3, time 0.2 (dead), expired-but-complete flat +0.1; hint penalty 0.05 each; clamp [0,1] (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:956-965)
First-try bonus: 0.05 engineering (minigame end path), but 0.10 default inside calculate_engineering_rewards (core/reward_calculator.py:52-62, 419)
Device base stats 100 each (durability/efficiency/accuracy/power); per-puzzle bonus int(5 + 15×efficiency) rotating through stats i%4 (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:936-950)

earned_points = int(performance×100), max_points 100; crafted quality = earned/max×100, durability_multiplier = (quality−50)/100 (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:1000-1001; entities/components/crafted_stats.py:83-90)

REWARD_MULTIPLIER 1.0→2.5 over normalized difficulty; bonus_pct = perf×(mult−1)×20 int; reward time bonus factor 0.2; reward hint penalty 0.1 each; efficiency_multiplier factor 0.4; durability_bonus ≤ +50 (core/reward_calculator.py:28-31, 143, 408-411, 426-427)
QUALITY_TIERS: Normal [0,0.25), Fine [0.25,0.50), Superior [0.50,0.75), Masterwork [0.75,0.90), Legendary [0.90,1.01) (core/reward_calculator.py:34-40)
FAILURE_PENALTIES by tier: 0.30/0.45/0.60/0.75/0.90 material loss (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:1229-1235)
Abandon (minigame-side, unused): 50% materials returned (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:877-889)
INT: −0.02 difficulty per point, cap 30 effective, engineering time-limit multiplier cap 1.6 (core/game_engine.py:4310-4311, 4386)
Double-ESC abandon window 1500ms (core/game_engine.py:715)
UI: window 1000×700; displayed 'max_bonus' = 1.0 + difficulty_points×0.02 (display only, not the reward formula) (core/game_engine.py:10488, 10546)
Legacy fallback: points=tier×15, grid=3+tier, hints=max(0,4−tier), ideal_moves=min(8,5+tier), puzzle_count 2/2/3/4 (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:697-718)
hazards: BUG-TO-PRESERVE: end() sets active=False BEFORE reading get_time_remaining(), which returns 0 when inactive → time_ratio is ALWAYS 0.0; finishing early earns +0 time bonus while finishing after expiry earns flat +0.1, so an expired-but-complete run scores HIGHER than a fast clean run; the 'time_remaining' passed to rewards is likewise always 0 (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:918, 931-932, 749-755, 959-962, 981)

puzzle_count = max(2, calculator value) where calculator range is (1,2) → every engineering craft has exactly 2 puzzles regardless of difficulty (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:681; core/difficulty_calculator.py:493)

Hints are dead: hints_used initialized to 0 and never incremented anywhere; hints_allowed computed but never consumed → hint penalties (0.05 and 0.1) never fire (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:649, 964; no engine writes — verified by repo grep)

attempt is always 1 (set once, never incremented) → both first-try bonuses apply on every craft: +0.05 to minigame performance AND +0.10 inside calculate_engineering_rewards' separate score (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:648, 968-970; core/reward_calculator.py:417-420)

calculate_engineering_rewards receives 'efficiency' in the performance dict but ignores it — reward-side score uses only completion/time/hints (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:975-984; core/reward_calculator.py:398-414)

first_try_bonus('engineering')=0.05 override exists but calculate_engineering_rewards reads FIRST_TRY_BONUS['performance_boost']=0.10 directly — intentional-looking inconsistency, preserve both (core/reward_calculator.py:52-74, 419)

Pipe efficiency is decided at generation (ideal/actual path length), not by player skill; clicks counter exists but is unscored; scramble can randomly leave the puzzle already solved, and BFS accepts any connected route including distractor pieces (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:153-157, 205-220, 222-285)
Logic switch reset() zeroes the moves counter → player can reset freely to guarantee 1.0 efficiency once they know the solution (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:501-504)

Abandon paths are dead code: engine's double-ESC just nulls active_minigame WITHOUT calling abandon() or consuming materials (materials are only consumed in _complete_minigame), so the 'materials lost' warning and the crafter's tier-scaled abandoned-refund branch never execute (core/game_engine.py:709-726, 8950-8973; Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:877-889, 1238-1253)

Difficulty-tier threshold GAPS: fractional points in (4,5), (10,11), (20,21), (40,41) match no range and fall through to 'common' — engineering totals are usually fractional due to multipliers, so e.g. 10.5 pts → 'common' tier (affects puzzle difficulty labels and failure penalty tier) (core/difficulty_calculator.py:47-53, 764-772)

Duck-typing key fallback asymmetry: can_craft/deduction accept itemId OR materialId, but rarity uniformity reads ONLY 'materialId' → itemId-only inputs silently count as 'common' rarity (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:1127-1131; Crafting-subdisciplines/rarity_utils.py:104-105)

Timer is wall-clock time.time(), not dt accumulation: update(dt) ignores dt; engine skips update() while the blocking metadata overlay shows, but the clock still runs — overlay reading time counts against the limit (expiry just fires on the next unblocked frame) (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:737-747; core/game_engine.py:8554-8558)

'complexity' difficulty param is computed and stored but never used by any puzzle constructor (only grid_size, difficulty label, ideal_moves matter) (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:683, 757-796)
RotationPipePuzzle's difficulty argument is stored but unused in generation — grid_size is the only real knob (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:62-74)
buff_quality_bonus is accepted and stored but never read (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:641-645)

craft_with_minigame does NOT deduct materials (engine consumes via RecipeDatabase after it returns) but craft_instant DOES deduct from the passed inventory dict — asymmetric contract (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:1167-1170, 1262-1263)
load_progress is a no-op TODO; save_progress serializes states but nothing restores them (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:905-913)

time_expired auto-end still produces result.success=True with partial credit — there is no failure state from timing out; the crafter's non-success branch is unreachable for engineering (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:744-747, 1003, 1255-1260)

Order dependence: skill buff time bonus multiplies time_limit in __init__, THEN engine INT multiplier applies on the instance before start() — both compound (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:655-659; core/game_engine.py:4382-4393)

get_state() calls check_solution() every frame for the pipe puzzle (BFS per render) — Godot port should keep solved-state semantics identical even if cached (Crafting-subdisciplines/engineering.py:287-301)
